summary.text: Jorin Johnson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 41 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Johnson's standing committee assignments as Industry, Business and Labor (vice chair) and Energy and Natural Resources.
